rule: Before launching the proxy, identify who holds the port (not just processes we spawned). Free it only if it is ciadpi; otherwise report the owner by name and pid instead of a bare bind error.

Recover from environment conflicts automatically instead of asking the user to fix them. When changing the host/extension protocol, gate new behaviour behind a flag the new extension sends, so already-installed extension versions never get a reply they misinterpret.

Bump HOST_VERSION (dpi_host.py / $HostVersion in both dpi_host.ps1 copies) on every host change, and manifest version on every extension change, so the popup's error panel identifies exactly what ran.
